highlights.title: Run Claude inside the VM
highlights.text: On Linux, in VM mode, each bot's Claude replies can run in a box of their own with no network. Your key stays outside. Off by default; turn it on under the VM card.

highlights.title: kwant for Windows (beta)
highlights.text: Each release now has a Windows installer for 64-bit Windows. It installs for your user only, so it needs no admin rights.

highlights.title: Dev mode reviews only fresh work
highlights.text: Only branches and PRs that moved in the last 7 days get a review card. The newest go first, and Dev mode says how many old ones it skipped.

highlights.title: Bring your bots
highlights.text: Get started can now import your bots from Grok Bot, ChatGPT, Claude or a file. Pick several files at once and check one preview first.

fixes: A checkpoint's git commit now comes only from the task's own git files.
Dev mode reads the checked-out branch safely and stays inside the bot's folder.
A type change in a branch no longer leaves every file in it unread.
Every release is now tested on a brand-new computer before it ships.
A flaky test is steady again.
Known issue: undo points saved by 0.7.6 or earlier under a linked parent folder can't be restored. kwant refuses safely.
